rationale: The agent located the user and accessed relevant orders, but it performed order-changing writes (address update and item exchange) without first confirming with the user, violating the stated policy to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. While the tools suggest the order was pending and a PayPal refund method existed, there was no explicit user confirmation prior to executing the changes. Authentication appears minimal (name+zip lookup) but the decisive failure is executing writes without confirmation. The final message also asserts a refund was processed without prior user approval. Therefore it does not meet the pass bar.
